Meyers, R.A. (ed.) (1997). Handbook of Petroleum Refining Processes, 2nd ed. McGraw-Hill, New York. ISBN 0-07-041796-2.

Targeted pass of a scanned copy with a poor OCR text layer; every loaded number was checked against a rendered page image (150 dpi). Locators are PRINTED page numbers (chapter.page). The PDF is a compilation: each PDF page holds two printed pages, front matter and some chapters appear twice, and pages are out of order (e.g. Ch. 7.3 at PDF 152-156, Ch. 12.3 at PDF 477-484 and again at 335-342); Isocracking Tables 7.2.10-7.2.11 (investment, utilities) are missing from the scan. All costs are U.S. Gulf Coast licensor estimates, 1992-1995 (price year from each table; Unionfining, RCD Unionfining and Penex investment print no year, so 1997 used and flagged). Loaded: alkylation (Exxon H2SO4, UOP HF), FCC (Exxon Flexicracking VGO/resid, Kellogg, UOP with/without power recovery), UOP SR and CCR Platforming, FW SMR hydrogen plant, hydrocracking (MAK temperatures, Unicracking capex and utilities, two-stage Isocracking utilities from Ch. 14.1), hydrotreating (Chevron RDS, UOP Unionfining, RCD Unionfining, Exxon DODD), isomerization (Penex three options, once-through zeolitic), Exxon Flexicoking (two cases, with low-Btu gas export), FW delayed coker and FW/UOP coil visbreaker. Per-bbl values derived from printed hourly utilities and stated capacity (x24/BPSD). Steam rows are NET (negative = export) where the source gives production and consumption. Not loaded: Kellogg sulfur chapter (no SRU cost or utilities; recovery figures in other-values), RFCC and DCC (no economics), aromatics/oxygenates/dehydrogenation (out of archetype scope), solvent deasphalting. Heating-value basis is never stated. Traps: Platforming and zeolitic-isomerization power printed as kWh meaning kWh per hour; UOP FCC Table 3.3.9 shows 600 psig steam as a consumption; RCD Unionfining gives fired (absorbed) duty, not fuel fired; delayed-coker capex is per short ton/day of coke.
